site: Neighborhood streets of Riverside and Avondale
about: Riverside Avondale Preservation says Luminaria has gathered friends, family and neighbors for one Sunday evening each December for 42 years.
This year's poster artwork is by local artist Marissa Perna. Her flowers are a hybrid of a magnolia and a white poinsettia, drawn as a nod to the holiday season in Florida.
The preservation group sells luminary kits online and says it funds more than 5,000 kits to light the 26 public parks in Riverside and Avondale. It also offers a Pick Up Party on Friday, December 18.
The group says it provides kits free of charge to neighborhood churches, community spaces, merchant districts and other public areas.
The Cummer Museum lets guests begin or end the walk at its front lawn with live music, warm drinks and seasonal bites from the Cummer Cafe, plus a festive art making activity for all ages.
